**No. Today a suspended guest can't be restored, either automatically or through an appeal.** `GuestsService.suspendGuest` (`src/guests/guests.service.ts:216-242`) is the only guest suspension code. There is no guest method that lifts a suspension, and no guest status transition back to active.

**Methods that restore suspended users today (regular and verified users only):**
- `RegularUsersService.liftSuspensionByPhoneNumber` (`src/regular-users/regular-users.service.ts:372`) sets the status to ACTIVE and clears the suspended fields.
- `VerifiedUsersService.liftSuspensionByPhoneNumber` (`src/verified-users/verified-users.service.ts:670`) does the same for verified users.
- `AppealsService.liftSuspensionByPhoneNumber` (`src/appeals/appeals.service.ts:172`) calls one of the two above.
  - It looks the user up by phone number: verified users first, then regular users (`:176-199`).
  - If neither matches, it returns "Appellant phone number not found" (`:201-204`).
- `AppealsService.updateStatus` (`src/appeals/appeals.service.ts:100`) calls that method when an appeal is APPROVED (`:110-114`). The controller route is `POST :id/status` (`src/appeals/appeals.controller.ts:122-138`).
- The cron job (`JobsService.handleRestoreSuspendedUsers`, `src/jobs/jobs.service.ts:537-584`) lifts suspensions older than `RESTORE_SUSPENDED_USERS_AFTER_DAYS`.
  - It is registered at `:160` and is off by default (`.env.example:133`).
  - It only queries `getSuspendedUsersExceedNumberOfDays` on the regular-user service (`:546-549`, defined at `src/regular-users/regular-users.service.ts:411`) and the verified-user service (`:551-554`, defined at `src/verified-users/verified-users.service.ts:709`).
- The admin status update (`src/admin/admin.service.ts:317-367` for regular users, `:574-679` for verified users) can move a user out of SUSPENDED. I only read the part that clears the suspension fields (`:364-367`) and did not trace whether guests are covered.

**Why the existing paths skip guests:**
- Appeals are keyed on `appellantPhoneNumber`, and the guest entity has no phone number, only `deviceId` (`src/guests/entities/guest.entity.ts:35`).
- The cron job never queries guests.

**Where guest restore would have to be added:**
1. **`GuestsService`:** add `liftSuspension(guestId)`, mirroring `suspendGuest`. It should set the status back to ACTIVE and null `suspendedAt`, `suspendedType` and `suspendedRefId`. The `GuestStatus.SUSPENDED` enum is at `src/guests/enums/guest-status.enum.ts:3`.
2. **A `getSuspendedGuestsExceedNumberOfDays` query:** model it on `src/regular-users/regular-users.service.ts:411-429`. Call it from `handleRestoreSuspendedUsers` (`src/jobs/jobs.service.ts:546-575`) and inject `GuestsService` into `JobsService`. Note that `suspendGuest` can set `suspendedAt` to null (`:230-236`), and the `suspendedAt < cutoff` filter would never match those rows.
3. **The appeal path:** `AppealsService.liftSuspensionByPhoneNumber` (`src/appeals/appeals.service.ts:172-204`) needs a guest branch, and the appeal needs a guest identifier. For example, add a `deviceId` or `guestId` column to the appeal entity (`src/appeals/entities/appeal.entity.ts`) and extend the create-appeal DTO.
4. **Admin:** if admins should be able to restore guests manually, add that to `src/admin/admin.service.ts`.
